Serious closed mouth and clean chin, blue-gray uniform with red-edged collar-tab areas, small pale marks and central neck fastening remain; unresolved tiny rank strokes are not treated as separately legible symbols. Compact round mascot head and short broad neck fit the widened original collar without clipping, long pillar neck or white belly at neckline. The dark frame, shaded internal backing and aged lower-right paper are retained; exterior transparency is intentional. Whole-image alpha extrema are [0, 255]. Finite interior sampling is numerical support only, not a claim of globally255 interiors. Composites show no material internal holes.
